newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Nan Ya plans bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Nan Ya plans bond issue.

text.p: Taiwan's Nan Ya Plastics Corp said on Thursday it planned to launch a corporate bond issue soon to raise funds for operations, the fifth of the kind so far this year issued by Formosa Plastics Group.
The group has three key members -- Formosa Plastics, Nan Ya Plastics and Formosa Chemical and Fiber.

Nan Ya issued T$5 billion and T$4 billion of bonds in March and June, respectively. "We have decided to launch another corporate bond issue soon, and we will decide details within one month," Nan Ya spokesman Wu Chia-chao said by telephone.
The fund will be used to help finance Nan Ya's expansion projects, including a US$9 billion naphtha cracker project the group launched in 1993 in central Taiwan, Wu said.
Construction of the complex, including a naphtha cracker and an oil refinery, will take six years to complete.
This issue would be the fifth time the group, Taiwan's largest industrial conglomerate, has issued corporate bonds this year.
Formosa Plastics issued T$4.2 billion of bonds in October and Formosa Chemical will issue T$4.5 billion of bonds in December.
